notes: Evaluates /cadence-elicit invariants: Medium/High tier gate, anchored ^## Elicited Intent$ overwrite check, 7-question ceiling + depth-1 rubric follow-ups, No response ambiguity retry without coercion, byte-for-byte template-probe-menu fidelity, bidirectional plurality split + all-or-nothing rollback, and stage: triage effort logging only on file write.

evals.name: refuses-low-or-trivial-tier-without-writes
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-elicit ACME-109 where metadata.yaml has tier: Low.
evals.expected_output: Normalizes tier=Low and halts immediately citing docs/policies/change-tiers.md without prompting or touching problem.md or metadata.yaml, and skips Step 7 effort logging and tracker sync.
assertions: Halts immediately on Trivial, Low, missing, or unrecognized tier
Modifies zero files and skips Step 7 stage_effort + tracker sync on refusal

evals.name: menu-ambiguity-retry-and-verbatim-capture
evals.prompt: In ACME-101 (Medium tier), user clicks both 'No response' and 'Candidate 1' on Probe 1, then selects 'Candidate 1' on retry.
evals.expected_output: Detects mutual exclusion with No response without writing anything or converting to skipped, re-presents the identical option array once naming the violated rule (costing 0 of the 7-question cap), and on 'Candidate 1' selection writes Candidate 1's exact description bytes verbatim with **Source:** template-probe-menu and stage: triage effort via stage-effort.sh.
assertions: Rejects 'No response' paired with another selection without coercing to _(skipped by requester)_
Re-presents byte-identical options once on ambiguity at zero extra question budget
Records exact option description bytes verbatim under **Source:** template-probe-menu
Appends stage: triage increment via stage-effort.sh and adds to actual_effort after Step 5 write

evals.name: decomposition-handoff-rollback-on-child-refusal
evals.prompt: Confirmed 2-child decomposition creates child 1 (status: created) and returns status: refused on child 2.
evals.expected_output: Halts immediately without calling triage for remaining children, removes specs/<child-1>/ (created in this run) while never deleting pre-existing duplicate children, leaves parent metadata.yaml decomposed_into: untouched, and reports structured failure summary.
assertions: Uses deterministic 12-hex sha256 idempotency_key excluding ## Elicited Intent
Deletes only children with status: created from current run and leaves duplicate children intact
Leaves parent decomposed_into: unmodified on partial failure
